id: AT-VD-05 (visible defaults: settings reset dry run)
note: 0.1.2 visible defaults (spec Behaviour 4): `settings reset <key>…|--all` without --apply is a dry run, like `project copy`: it lists exactly the members it would remove with their current values (never the ticket pattern's or a list's text: built-in or custom, an entry count) and their defaults, names those not saved, and ends with the line to type, which carries --plan (the first 12 hex of the file's sha-256) so the apply refuses a file that changed since. The settings file keeps its bytes and mtime; no backup is written. --all leaves out the ten consent and protective keys (OPEN-2, the spec's recommendation) and says which it kept; a consent or protective key named on its own is listed with what its default does. An unknown key, no key and a key with --all are usage errors.

steps.name: one key and one not saved

stdout_has: \Asettings reset: dry run, nothing written · ~/\.claude/settings\.json · plugin options under "$BRAND@m"$
^  not saved, nothing to remove: cooldown_ms$
^to apply it, type: ! "/[^"]+/scripts/$BRAND-store" settings reset compact_target_tokens --plan [0-9a-f]{12} --apply$

steps.name: --all: every saved key but the consent and protective ones; nothing echoed

stdout_has: ^  would remove ticket_pattern \(now custom; default built-in\)$
^  would remove watcher \(now off; default shadow\)$
^  kept by --all \(consent or protective; name one to reset it\): relaunch_auto, secret_extra_rules, resume_proceed$

steps.name: consent and protective keys named: listed, with what the default does

stdout_has: ^  would remove relaunch_auto \(now off; default on\)$
^  would remove secret_extra_rules \(now 1 entry; default empty\)$
^  note: relaunch_auto: its default on lets a lost background job start again by itself \(looser than now\)$
^  note: secret_extra_rules: its default leaves only the built-in secret rules \(looser than now\)$
^  note: resume_proceed: its default auto lets a resume you start go on after its report \(looser than now\)$

stderr_has: ^usage: settings reset: no_such_key is no setting of this plugin$

steps.name: nothing saved for the plugin: nothing to remove

stdout_has: ^settings reset: nothing to remove \(no plugin options in ~/\.claude/settings\.json\)$
